name: scroll-chapter
description: 滚动驱动的分段式叙事阅读器
tagline: Scroll through stories, chapter by chapter.
interaction: The page is divided into full-screen chapters that transition smoothly as the user scrolls, with parallax backgrounds and animated text reveals creating an immersive reading experience. Progress is tracked via a subtle chapter indicator, and each section morphs into the next with cinematic easing. Users can also use keyboard arrows or click navigation dots for direct chapter access.
